thought.text: Saya cek data login akun obscurify — apakah ada email/password-nya.

reasoning_content:
User wants to know WHICH account this key belongs to so they can check on the website. They need the account credentials (email/password) to log in to obscurify website, not just the account ID.

Let me check what info ob_accounts.txt has and whether there's email/password data. The file format is `id | key | saldo` — only ID and key. No email/password.

Let me check if there's another file with emails/passwords for obscurify accounts.

Also, the account ID `2632024290223673` — is that a login credential? Obscurify might use account number for login. Let me check ob.py to see how accounts are created and what identifies them.

Let me look for email/password records.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && echo "=== format ob_accounts.txt ==="; head -3 ob_accounts.txt; echo; echo "=== cari file akun obscurify lain ==="; ls -1 | grep -iE "ob|obscur" ; echo; echo "=== apakah ada email/password di file obscurify? ==="; grep -rlE "obscurify" *.txt *.json 2>/dev/null | head; echo; echo "=== cek ob.py: apa yg disimpan saat daftar ==="; grep -nE "email|password|account_number|write|open\(" ob.py | head -20
